stories.title: MGM Resorts misses Q3 2026 EPS estimates, but shares hold steady
stories.summary: MGM Resorts reported third-quarter 2026 earnings per share below analyst estimates, according to an earnings call transcript carried by Investing.com. Despite the miss, the stock steadied rather than sold off. The transcript does not specify the exact size of the miss or management's stated reason for it.
stories.whyItMatters: MGM is a bellwether for US consumer spending on travel and gaming, so a muted stock reaction to a miss says something about investor confidence in the sector.
whatToWatch: Analyst commentary on what offset the EPS miss
Next quarter's guidance from management
questions: Why did shares steady instead of falling on the miss?
